stories.title: Twin Cities-area ski hills make their own winter as cold weather returns
stories.summary: Trollhaugen and Wild Mountain plan to reopen Wednesday, while other metro ski hills take advantage of colder temperatures to make snow.

stories.title: The ‘Ultimate Rally’ for a south Minneapolis hospice patient
stories.summary: Facing a terminal diagnosis, the University of Minnesota Marching Band helped knock off an item of a south Minneapolis woman’s bucket list.

stories.title: Pilgrim's Pride facing more than $123K in fines after employee's death in June
stories.summary: A 29-year-old employee died after being pinned underneath equipment in the loading dock at the Cold Spring facility.

stories.title: Mayo Clinic to pay more than $900K in back wages to some employees
stories.summary: As part of the settlement, Mayo Clinic will pay employees $906,088.88 in back wages and also agreed to policy changes, including no longer rounding time for workers.

stories.title: H Mart plans to open a new location in Midway Marketplace
stories.summary: The country's largest Asian grocery chain will anchor the shopping plaza where Cub Foods closed in 2025.

stories.title: Minneapolis sees success with new program where a social worker answers 911 mental health and addiction calls
stories.summary: The city of Minneapolis and Hennepin County joined forces to test out the idea of embedding a social worker into the 911 call center to answer calls.

stories.title: Nicollet Avenue now reopen near Lake Street for first time in nearly 50 years
stories.summary: The area was occupied by a Kmart before the city demolished it in 2023.

stories.title: Woman sentenced to 27 months in prison for role in Feeding Our Future scheme
stories.summary: In March, Aisha Hussein pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud.

stories.title: Author shares book inspired by 60th anniversary of 'Star Trek'
stories.summary: Author Jeffrey Morris will be at Inkwell Booksellers in Minneapolis on Dec. 3 to sign books.

stories.title: Minneapolis City Council fails to override mayor's veto over data centers
stories.summary: The council needed at least nine affirmative votes for a successful override, but fell short with a vote of 7-5.

stories.title: Minnesota food shelves see rising demand as holiday season approaches
stories.summary: The state is on track for a fifth consecutive year of record-breaking demand, according to The Food Group, a statewide food access nonprofit.

stories.title: Skip the shops: Minnesota state parks offer free admission on Black Friday
stories.summary: You can take the whole family for outdoor exercise this Friday.
